description.en: Your recent pull requests in the sidebar, open and merged, newest first: the ones you opened, were asked to review or are assigned. Click one to open it in a browser tab.

tagline.en: The pull requests you touched lately, newest first

scopes.integration:github:read: Read your pull requests through your connected GitHub account, without seeing its token.
scopes.actions:run: Open a pull request in a browser tab when you click it.

optionalScopes.net:api.github.com: Without a connected account, read the public pull requests of the GitHub login you set in this app's settings.
